title: Access Sentinel: consolidated access + audit synthesis for org/workspace settings
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design a unified console surface (Access Sentinel) that synthesizes org-level and workspace-level RBAC, exposes anomalous grants, links directly to audit-log replays, and surfaces cost/rollout implications for permission changes. Focus is on reducing admin time to identify risky grants, improve least-privilege reviews, and provide a safe rollback path for staged role changes.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Single-page summary shows: top 5 anomalous grants, aggregated exposure score, and estimated monthly cost delta for permission changes.
2) Admin can pivot from a grant row to the audit-log replay anchored at the first anomalous event.
3) Prototype supports a staged rollout widget (canary -> broad) with suggested rollback triggers and a metrics preview.
4) Usability test median time to identify a risky grant < 2 minutes.
5) Design handoff artifacts (Figma, tokens, motion specs) uploaded; dev signoff in PR linked.
prototype_notes: Prototype built in Figma with interactive audit-replay microflows. Two main panes: (A) Top-level Insight Strip (exposure score, top anomalies, cost delta), (B) Details pane (grant timeline, implicated routes, users, and a staged rollout controller). Interaction patterns: inline filtering by role, time-window scrubber on timeline, and a contextual 'safe-revoke' button that opens the rollback modal. Motion uses 80ms easing for pane transitions to preserve perceivable responsiveness.
usability_findings: Remote moderated test with 6 internal participants (2 platform engineers, 2 security reviewers, 2 PMs). Key takeaways: (a) Exposure score quickly guides attention but needed a tooltip explaining calculation (added). (b) Users expected a link from grant to the underlying API logs; added a direct deep-link. (c) Staged rollout explanations were misread—reworded copy and added an example scenario. Measured median time-to-identify decreased from ~4.2m (current console task baseline) to 1.6m in prototype tasks.
engineering_feedback: ENG early review notes: (1) Audit-replay deep-link should accept event cursor param; ENG-19204 will add API support. (2) Cost delta estimates require a lightweight query to billing-service; suggested caching layer to avoid spikes—ENG-19877. (3) Can only show 'safe-revoke' suggestion if KV cache invalidation and route ownership checks exist—needs coordination with runtime team. Follow-up ticket recommended: ENG-20011.
decisions: 1) Use exposure score combining grant age, number of principals, and recent activity (weight 0.5/0.3/0.2). 2) Staged rollout UI will default to canary=5% users for cross-workspace role changes. 3) 'Safe-revoke' will generate a proposed rollback change packaged as a diff + preflight checklist rather than performing destructive ops automatically. 4) Accessibility: all interactive elements must be keyboard reachable and have ARIA labels.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: False positives from exposure score may create alert fatigue. Mitigation: add a 'confidence' toggle and allow filtering by minimum confidence; instrument feedback CTA to collect false-positive signals.
Risk: Performance impact from live billing estimates. Mitigation: show cached estimate with a last-updated timestamp and an explicit 'refresh' action.
next_steps: 1) Resolve ENG-19204 and ENG-19877 dependencies. 2) Finalize wording with legal for audit-storage links. 3) Push a high-fidelity prototype to developer handoff board and create GH PR template with endpoint contracts. 4) Schedule stakeholder review (Security, Platform, Billing) for 2026-03-18. 5) Run another 6-person usability round focused on error states and mobile/compact widths.
